audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[].side rows (Syndra/Syndra/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra) disagree with the content win[] rows and packet.levelChart, which both read Skill/Skill/Syndra/Syndra/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko.
audit.why: Content and packet agree with each other and with the kit: levels 1-2 are even, Syndra's Dark Sphere stun rotation takes over at 3-5, and Ekko's Chronobreak plus first item flips it from 6 onward. The full layer was simply stale.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..6].side set to Skill/Skill/Syndra/Syndra/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko with ratings and whys rewritten in the same group.

audit.why: Spike timings were right; they lacked numbers. Unleashed Power is 120/100/80 and Chronobreak 110/80/50, so Ekko's insurance cycles faster than her kill ultimate at rank 1 — now stated in phases[4].why and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Syndra ability was named (packet defect) and two decisive interactions were absent: Transcendent/Force of Will deal true damage, and Transcendent/Unleashed Power execute below a threshold.
audit.why: True damage means armour and MR are the wrong purchase in this matchup; the execute means the player must track an HP number rather than a health bar. Neither was on the page. Scatter the Weak is also a flat 15s at every rank — by far the longest non-ultimate cooldown in her kit and the entire punish window.
audit.corrected: Named Dark Sphere, Force of Will, Scatter the Weak, Unleashed Power and Transcendent's effects; folded true damage and the execute into enemyWin and breakdown.feeding; put the flat 15s E and flat 7s Q into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Scatter the Weak flat 15s, Dark Sphere flat 7s, Unleashed Power 120s, Chronobreak 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 lint entries: Syndra called he/his/him across tldr, tradeGood, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].t and five report entries; plus COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: All non-report misgendered fields fixed; both bleeds replaced with bodies that match their titles. Only two report entries rewritten, per the sweep cap.
